mapper.select: {CALL sp_save_webauthn_credential( #{operation, mode=IN, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{credential.id, mode=IN, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{credential.credentialId, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{credential.publicKeyCose, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{credential.counter, mode=IN, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{credential.transports, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{credential.label, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{credential.user.id, mode=IN, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{credential.createdAt, mode=IN, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{credential.lastUsedAt, mode=IN, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{resultId, mode=OUT, jdbcType=BIGINT} )}

SELECT c.id, c.credential_id, c.public_key_cose, c.counter, c.transports, c.label, c.user_id, c.created_at, c.last_used_at, u.id as user_id, u.username, u.password, u.email, u.display_name, u.user_handle, u.enabled, u.account_non_expired, u.account_non_locked, u.credentials_non_expired FROM webauthn_credentials c INNER JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT c.id, c.credential_id, c.public_key_cose, c.counter, c.transports, c.label, c.user_id, c.created_at, c.last_used_at, u.id as user_id, u.username, u.password, u.email, u.display_name, u.user_handle, u.enabled, u.account_non_expired, u.account_non_locked, u.credentials_non_expired FROM webauthn_credentials c INNER JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.credential_id = #{credentialId}

SELECT id, credential_id, public_key_cose, counter, transports, label, created_at, last_used_at, user_id, username, password, email, display_name, user_handle, enabled, account_non_expired, account_non_locked, credentials_non_expired FROM v_webauthn_credentials WHERE user_id = #{userId}
